evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence reviewed during Skill Research Batch 459.
findings: 0-Ki Power Up Super from PQ122. Completing the meditation stance raises maximum Ki to 1500 and grants temporary Ki Auto-Recovery for 20 seconds. Current evidence describes the charge as hold-to-complete and notes that the effect can coexist with other Power-Up effects during its 20-second duration. Exact recovery rate, startup, and frame timing remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Exact frame data is not promoted.
Patch-independent scaling is not inferred from source-reported values.
Reward probabilities and hidden prerequisites are not promoted unless directly evidenced.
